newsitem.title: ITALY: U.N.'s WFP to attempt eastern Zaire evacuation.
newsitem.headline: U.N.'s WFP to attempt eastern Zaire evacuation.

text.p: The U.N. World Food Programme said on Monday that it would try to evacuate U.N. personnel and staff of non-governmental organisations (NGOs) from eastern Zaire on Tuesday.
It said this followed a last-minute decision by Zairean authorities to allow a WFP-chartered plane to fly into the regional centre of Uvira.

U.N. and NGO staff were trying to flee fighting in eastern Zaire between soldiers and ethnic Tutsi rebels, it said. The conflict has forced tens of thousands of Hutu refugees from Rwanda and Burundi from their camps in search of a safe haven.
The WFP estimated that between 44 and 54 U.N. and other aid workers were in the region, including two of its own staff.
The Rome-based WFP had been providing emergency food rations to about 225,00 refugees in Uvira.
